svg.title: Transgender medicine pathway: assess gender dysphoria, then climb the reversibility ladder from puberty blockers (fully reversible) through masculinizing or feminizing hormones (partially reversible) to surgery (irreversible), with the criteria, regimens, effects, risks and monitoring at each step
